sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B model card at audited revision
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact family member; describes approximately 35B total and 3B active per token, MIT licensing, reasoning and function calls, and a native 262144-token context. Larger windows require YaRN scaling.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.evidence: August 2026 announcement explicitly includes the 35B MoE variant and describes reinforcement learning with generated tasks, scaffolds and solution rollouts. It labels active size as 3B; no exact day is shown.

sources.title: Exact Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration with 40 language layers, repeating three linear-attention layers and one full-attention layer, 256 experts/top 8, a shared expert, 262144 positions, 27 vision layers and one MTP layer. BF16; untied embeddings; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint index and all 16 indexed safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Bounded HTTP206 reads of all 16 JSON headers yield 1811 unique indexed tensors and 35951822704 BF16 learned parameters: 34660610688 language plus output head, 446571248 vision, and 844640768 auxiliary MTP. Shape products match contiguous data offsets and the index total_size of 71903645408 bytes. No quantization scales, packed tensors or persistent rotary buffers appear; no full weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint image and video processor configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3VLProcessor specifies both image and video processing, including sampled video frames and temporal patches.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Handles text, image/image_url and video content. Formats tools, function calls, responses and reasoning blocks; thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled with enable_thinking=false.

sources.title: Official model repository commit chronology
sources.evidence: Initial commit is 2026-08-18 06:24:38 UTC; first weight upload a111f308b7a9fc99010afd1d412ae92969f854ad is 2026-08-18 08:34:29 UTC. The audited current revision is an August 23 update, not the first release.

sources.title: First complete weight-upload tree
sources.evidence: The first August 18 upload contains all 16 indexed weight shards, config, processors and template. The earlier initial tree has only attributes and a license-only README, so repository creation was checked separately from first weights.

sources.title: Official Ornith organization profile
sources.evidence: The organization explicitly identifies itself as the DeepReinforce team and links the Ornith website and model repositories.

sources.title: Transformers implementation for the declared architecture
sources.evidence: A_log, dt_bias and packed expert projection arrays are nn.Parameter objects; rotary-frequency buffers are nonpersistent. Standard Transformers excludes auxiliary mtp.* checkpoint keys from its inference module, but these are learned weights present in this complete checkpoint.

sources.title: Publisher model metadata and safetensors tally
sources.evidence: Current revision matches 10fbf86fed7ecee4a061f8b499a618f46001cac1; public ungated model metadata gives BF16 and total counts of 35951822704, independently agreeing with the bounded header recount.

sources.title: Initial repository tree before weight upload
sources.evidence: The August 18 06:24:38 UTC initial commit contains only .gitattributes and a 21-byte README declaring license: mit; it contains no checkpoint weights.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official exact model name; baseline confirmed.

developer.note: The publishing Ornith organization identifies itself as the DeepReinforce team.

family.note: Explicit member of the Ornith-1.5 family; baseline confirmed.

release_date.note: First complete checkpoint upload occurred August 18 at 08:34:29 UTC. This is evidence from the released weight history, separately checked against the earlier repository-only creation. Current August 23 weight update is not substituted for first release.

open_weights.note: All 16 checkpoint shards are publicly accessible without authentication.

license.note: Publisher README metadata declares MIT, including in the initial upload. The current card links a standalone LICENSE path that returns 404; the classification rests on the explicit publisher declaration.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count, not nominal 35B: 35951822704 BF16 parameters, including vision and auxiliary MTP. All header tensor names match the index. A_log and dt_bias are learned parameters; packed expert axes are ordinary BF16 parameter arrays, not quantized storage.

active_parameters_b.note: Publisher approximation per token, retained as nominal 3B. Exact counting convention and multimodal/MTP activation scope are not disclosed; not calculated from the routed-expert fraction.

architecture.note: MoE language model with hybrid attention: 30 linear-attention and 10 full-attention layers, 256 routed experts/top 8 plus shared expert, and a vision encoder. MoE is the catalog category; hybrid attention does not make it dense.

context_window.note: Native configured and documented context. Approximately 1M requires optional RoPE/YaRN scaling and is not the native default.

modalities.note: The released vision model, processor and chat template explicitly support both image and video inputs; add video omitted from the baseline.

reasoning.note: Model card and template establish thinking support; the template permits disabling it.

tool_call.note: Model card provides function-call examples; template encodes tool schemas, calls and responses.

description.value: Mixture-of-experts model with hybrid linear/full attention, trained through self-improvement for agentic coding, reasoning and tool use; accepts text, images and video.
description.note: Refines the supported baseline description with hybrid attention, self-improvement training and native video input; excludes performance-superiority claims.

patch.description: Mixture-of-experts model with hybrid linear/full attention, trained through self-improvement for agentic coding, reasoning and tool use; accepts text, images and video.
patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint contains 35,951,822,704 learned parameters: 34,660,610,688 language/output-head, 446,571,248 vision and 844,640,768 auxiliary MTP. The ordinary language-plus-vision model excluding MTP has 35,107,181,936 parameters; standard Transformers ignores MTP checkpoint keys. Publisher 35B total and 3B active are nominal; 3B is not an exact all-component activation count. Architecture combines MoE feed-forward blocks with linear/full attention. Native context is 262144; larger windows require YaRN scaling.

verification.method: Read 8-byte safetensors prefix and exact bounded JSON header from each indexed shard; require HTTP206, exact unique tensor coverage, BF16 dtype, shape-byte equality, contiguous nonoverlapping offsets, and element total times two equal to total_size. No full weight shards downloaded.

summary: Confirmed identity, DeepReinforce developer, August 18 first weight release, open weights, publisher-declared MIT, hybrid-attention MoE, 262144 context, thinking and tools. Corrected nominal 35B to complete 35.951822704B checkpoint count including auxiliary MTP and vision; retained publisher approximate 3B active and added native video input. Standalone LICENSE link is missing, but README metadata declares MIT. Exact active counting convention remains undisclosed.
